thread:
leah (product): Quick sync: customers asking for a simplified tenant archive policy UI + BYOK export escrow. Need to decide scope for MVP and what to gate behind Dedicated/Private.

omar (eng): MVP could be: retention_label per tenant (standard/extended/legal-hold), export-on-demand, and signed manifests. BYOK escrow is more complex (key wrapping + customer consent flow).

sana (security): Security must ensure manifests are tamper-evident and every export request records requester identity + justification. For BYOK escrow we need clear PoP (proof-of-possession) and an auditable key usage log.

tobias (sales): For enterprise deals, customers expect an "escrow bundle" that includes signed manifests, chain-of-custody notes, and KMS metadata. They'll pay for extended retention. Request a simple pricing/feature matrix in the spec.

kevin (infra): Operational items: label in object metadata, replication policy when retention=extended, and a TTL guard to prevent accidental deletion. Advised: gate replication/extended retention to tenants with purchase commit.

leah (product): Proposed launch criteria: 1) Tenant retention labels available in Console + API; 2) Export package includes manifest with sha256, signer_id, timestamp; 3) Legal-hold prevents deletion and surfaces in admin audit logs; 4) BYOK escrow documented as "enterprise opt-in alpha".

omar (eng): Implementation note: manifest generation adds CPU load for hashing; estimate +5-10% CPU for export-heavy tenants. We'll provide an option to include or skip per-file hashes for cost-sensitive customers.

sana (security): If skipping per-file hashes, require a warning that tamper-evidence is reduced. BYOK alpha should require security review and manual approval per customer.

tobias (sales): Good. Also ask: can we provide a short-runbook template for customers' auditors? That helps close deals.

kevin (infra): We'll add retention_label to blob metadata and a preflight check in deletion pipeline. Also propose a nightly job that re-validates legal-hold flags.

leah (product): Action items: @omar draft tech spec with manifest schema + opt-in hash flag (due Tue), @kevin add retention_label change to storage plan (due Tue), @sana start BYOK alpha security checklist (due Thu), @tobias collect customer runbook examples (due next Mon). If no objections I'll slot for Q2 backlog.

ops-bot: Reminder: product roadmap sync tomorrow 11:00 in #product.

leah (product): Thanks everyone, please call out blockers today.
